title: Kissed Golden Canadian Jersey Royal Potatoes Gratin
description: A festive Canadian dish featuring Jersey Royal potatoes in a rich and creamy herbal gratin, perfect for special occasions. This recipe combines the flavors of cheese, herbs, and potatoes in a delicious papillote-style dish.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large saucepan, combine the sliced potatoes and enough cold water to cover them, then bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer the potatoes for 5 minutes, or until they are slightly tender.
Drain the potatoes and set them aside.
In a small saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat, then add the chopped rosemary and cook for 1 minute, or until fragrant.
Add the minced garlic to the saucepan and cook for 1 minute, or until fragrant.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of potatoes, then sprinkle with some of the shredded gruyere cheese and drizzle with some of the heavy cream.
Repeat the layers two more times, finishing with a layer of cheese on top.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for 20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
